project: Wuxia Life P55 Merchant Magnate Bounded Expansion
description: Extend the current static merchant_magnate mixed-identity proof into a bounded merchant growth stage with minimal story configuration, player-facing expression, targeted simulation evidence, and narrow regression coverage, without reopening the closed sample-line track or expanding into a full economy system.

userStories.title: Audit merchant_magnate current evidence
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of the current merchant_magnate evidence chain so P55 extends real gaps rather than rebuilding already-proven surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize existing merchant_magnate static slices, path definitions, flags, and documents
Separate proven layers from missing runtime, content, or verification proof
Save docs/test-reports/p55-merchant-magnate-gap-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story

userStories.title: Lock merchant_magnate scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract for merchant_magnate so P55 stays bounded and does not sprawl into a full economy expansion.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit the stage to merchant_magnate bounded growth only
Define allowed layers: story configuration, light presentation, validation scripts
List forbidden expansions: Wave 4, full economy system, sample-line reopening, platformization
Save docs/test-reports/p55-merchant-magnate-scope-contract.md

userStories.title: Define merchant_magnate on-ramp contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a concrete on-ramp contract so merchant_magnate has a bounded early or mid-life entry path instead of a summary-only label.
acceptanceCriteria: Define at least two prerequisite groups such as merchant route plus wealth or capital pressure
Define one on-ramp milestone and one midlife pressure milestone
Keep current merchant-first, debt, and expansion semantics intact
Record the contract in the PRD or audit appendix

userStories.title: Define merchant_magnate payoff contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a bounded payoff contract so merchant_magnate ends in a recognizable merchant power state without requiring a full sandbox economy.
acceptanceCriteria: Define one magnate payoff node or terminal summary contract
Make the payoff combine wealth scale with duty, risk, or operating burden
Document how it differs from merchant_martial_patron and sample-line merchant payoff
Record the contract in the PRD or audit appendix

userStories.title: Wire merchant_magnate story configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the magnate chain wired through bounded configuration changes so the target path can actually occur without a new runtime framework.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement the on-ramp, pressure, and payoff chain through existing configuration carriers
Do not introduce a new configuration system
The path becomes triggerable in a benchmark or targeted simulation
Existing sample-line and P25 regression evidence does not regress

userStories.title: Add merchant_magnate player-facing expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want merchant_magnate to be visible in currentGoal, identity summary, or life-memory so the route reads as a distinct life arc rather than hidden bookkeeping.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least two readable merchant_magnate-specific signals on existing presentation surfaces
Keep the wording distinct from sample-line merchant debt or age-45 payoff text
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests

userStories.title: Add targeted merchant_magnate simulation slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded simulation slice for merchant_magnate so the stage proves runtime reachability beyond static path labels.
acceptanceCriteria: Add one targeted simulation or lifetime or near-lifetime slice
Assert merchant_magnate terminal outcome or equivalent proof
Record key age, flag, and event evidence
Do not require combinatorial exhaust

userStories.title: Add merchant_magnate regression tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests for merchant_magnate so future merchant edits do not silently erase the new path.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least one narrow assert each for on-ramp, payoff, and expression
Reuse the existing test harness without a new framework
Do not rewrite all merchant tests
Relevant commands pass

userStories.title: Produce merchant_magnate replay or audit artifact
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a readable artifact for the new magnate path so later sessions can verify the route without reopening code discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce one magnate-specific replay, audit, or trace artifact
Show key checkpoints, flags, recent events, or terminal summary in a readable format
